title: Ear Explorer Lab
objectives: Name the parts of the ear
Trace how a sound reaches the brain

stages.title: Journey Into the Ear
stages.narration: Shrink down and explore your own sound detector to find fragment 3!

steps.text: A faint chime hides deep in a giant model ear.
Echo Bot shrinks you down to explore.
A sound wave rolls in past the pinna…

stages.title: Parts of the Ear
stages.prompt: Tap each part to learn its job. Visit them all!

locations.label: Pinna
locations.info: The outer flap that collects sound and funnels it inward.

locations.label: Ear Canal
locations.info: The tube that carries the sound to the eardrum.

locations.label: Eardrum
locations.info: A thin stretched membrane that vibrates when sound hits it.

locations.label: Auditory Nerve
locations.info: Carries the signal to the brain to be recognised.

stages.title: Order the Journey of Sound
stages.prompt: For each step, choose whether it comes early, middle, or late in hearing.

tasks.label: Pinna collects the sound
tasks.explain: First the outer ear catches the sound.

questions.q: Which part vibrates when sound arrives?

questions.explain: The brain compares both ears to find direction.
